product_overview: Jhome Enterprise Platform is a public website and administrative dashboard for managing academy operations and platform content. The dashboard supports administrator login and academy management tasks such as managing courses and reviewing student enrollment requests.
core_goals: Log in as an administrator to access the dashboard
Manage academy courses through create, update, and delete workflows
Review student enrollment requests and approve enrollments
Access dashboard content from the main application route

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: Allows an administrator to sign into the dashboard using Firebase Authentication.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard after successful authentication
Navigate to / -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form with unauthorized credentials -> See an access denied error message

features.name: Jhome Academy Courses Management
features.description: Lets an authenticated user manage academy courses from the Academy area.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Navigate to Academy tab -> Add a course -> Fill in the course form -> Submit the course form -> See the new course appear in the course list

features.name: Jhome Academy Student Requests
features.description: Lets an authenticated user review enrollment requests for a course and approve students.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Navigate to Academy tab -> Open a course's Requests tab -> Review the list of enrollment requests -> Approve a request -> See generated credentials in a modal

routes.description: Main SPA page containing login and all admin dashboard views.

features.name: Jhome Academy Student Requests
features.description: View and approve student enrollment requests
user_interactions: Navigate to Requests tab in a course
